text:
arjun: quick ping — PR 9612 touches routing + kv cache eviction. Need runtime + security eyes before I merge today. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/9612 :eyes:
michelle: Thanks for the ping. Which canary window are you targeting?
arjun: aiming for canary at 18:00 PST. Small change: adaptive batching threshold and fallback route to smaller model when memory > 85%.
sam: @arjun i skimmed. main concern is async KV invalidation race. Can you add a guard in batching loop? sample patch below:
```
if (kv_cache.size() > max_kv_entries) {
  evict_prefixes(1);
}
```
arjun: good call, pushed fix in the branch (force-pushed). Also added unit test for race condition.
kevin: infra note: this will bump memory per-worker by ~150MB at peak in our staging profile. We should limit concurrency to avoid OOM during canary. I'll add nodepool cap.
security-bot: Static scan complete: no secrets found; flagged 1 high-risk dependency (old-jwt-lib). Suggest upgrade but not blocking for this PR.
michelle: ok from platform side if runtime approves and infra limits concurrency for canary. @sam can you take a final look?
sam: LGTM after the guard; approved. :white_check_mark:
arjun: thanks all — scheduling canary. @deploy-bot please schedule merge at 18:00 PST and limit concurrency to 2 for canary.
deploy-bot: Merge queued for 2026-03-17 18:00 PST. Canary options applied: concurrency=2, nodepool=isolated-canary. I'll post updates after rollout.
michelle: awesome, TY! :rocket:
